turns.speaker: holder

I'm happy to chat with you about other things, though - how about we talk about a hobby or interest of yours, or something you're looking forward to doing soon?

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: I understand your reluctance to share more about your finances, but I'm still a bit intrigued. Let me ask you this: are you comfortable sharing the general range of your retirement savings, just to give me an idea of how you've planned ahead? turns.speaker: holder
